title: MOD-0188 Demand v2 revision state event (DRAFT)
description: Producer outbox event schema draft. Not frozen or published. Events contain a revision reference, scope and integrity summary, never 52-week rows. A new Published revision requires a separate Superseded outbox intent for the prior current revision in the same state-and-audit transaction. Outbox persistence is not delivery. Delivery may repeat, lag or reorder; the authoritative v2 status API decides current state. MOD-0189 is the bound consumer and owns its MRP work and reconciliation; MOD-0191, S&OP and Capacity are candidate consumers pending confirmation.

eventVersion.description: Event schema version; distinct from monotonic stateVersion. Final value set at central freeze.

stateVersion.description: Monotonic revision status version; consumer must not order events by delivery time.

scopeDefinitionId.description: Identifier for a reproducible scope-summary definition; concrete definition is open.

scopeDigest.description: Summary of selected/excluded SKU x Warehouse scope. Full scope is read from the immutable manifest.

scopeSummary.description: Immutable selected/excluded SKU x Warehouse revision scope; not proof of the caller's current authorization, which must be checked separately.

definitionId.description: Whole-snapshot checksum using the exact ordered, length-prefixed UTF-8 canonicalization specified by demand-v2.openapi.yaml x-checksum-canonicalization.

businessImpact.description: Material MRP effect; natural forecast deviation alone is insufficient.

occurredAt.description: Server-recorded invalidation action time; top-level occurredAt is event occurrence time.

x-consumer-semantics: Same eventId replay has no second business effect.
Delivery order does not decide state; compare stateVersion and recheck authoritative status.

Publication occurs only after full part/row/checksum verification; Published and, when replacing a baseline, separate Superseded outbox intents are persisted atomically with both states and audit. Current producer code still lacks the Superseded intent; neither intent proves delivery.
Invalidation forbids new consumption. MOD-0189 owns stopping or marking its own runs and downstream proposals.
Tenant, LegalEntity and data scope must match the request context and pinned manifest; failure closes access.
A separate Superseded event for the replaced revision is required by the approved DRAFT design; event transport, topic and exact retry timing remain open.
